content.text:
I've stored a plan for t1, the first of 13 open threads on MR !4, and it's on the card for you to agree to.

- **What I found:** nothing in this MR reads `featureFlags` yet, so there's no hook to memoise in. The object is a module-level `as const` constant, so reading it is already just a property lookup.
- **Recommendation:** add the comment Bob asked for above `auditCache`, saying the default matches what production runs today. Reply to him that the memoised read will come with the hook that first reads the flags. Because his thread mentions a memoised read, the plan answers him before the fix.

No code has changed yet. Fixes wait until every open topic has an agreed plan.
